explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM-as-a-judge (principle-adherence evaluation) and human evaluation (creator and third-party ratings) were conducted, but the paper does not directly compare LLM judgments with human judgments on the same instances or report any quantitative metrics of agreement/correlation between them. The LLM and human evaluations are used independently to assess different aspects of the system performance.

prompts.notes: Detailed prompts for principle-elicitation kudos/critique/rewrite functions and principle-adherence pipeline stages are provided in Appendix E, including one-shot examples and JSON output formatting requirements.

guidelines.notes: Detailed questionnaires with 7-point Likert scales for creator study (Table 5 and 6) and third-party study (Appendix J.1) provided evaluation dimensions and instructions. Annotators ranked responses on specific metrics with clear criteria definitions.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluation focused on technical adherence to principles and dialogue coherence, while human evaluation assessed qualitative aspects like authenticity and training readiness. The evaluations were conducted independently without overlap in criteria.
